title: ctx.invoke passes Sentinel to command
root_cause_summary: ctx.invoke() was passing UNSET sentinel values through to the invoked command instead of resolving them to their actual defaults. The fix adds a check to hide UNSET values before passing kwargs to the command.
notes: No double-quoted strings. Backtick strings in issue include ctx.invoke, Sentinel. TypeError message in body. Pre-fix ref is same commit as C2 fix (chained bugs). Error Sources will find Sentinel and UNSET in core.py. Good Agent 1 stress case requiring call-chain reasoning.
